naming_evidence.verification: Canonical names below were checked against column F of the official AAPM workbook. This validates spelling, not clinical equivalence of local contours.

excluded_sheets.Mamma_5Fx: Special breast regimen; contains contralateral rules mixed with generic copied OAR rows. Requires separate laterality and prescription definition.
excluded_sheets.Mamma_15Fx: Special breast regimen; ipsilateral/contralateral names are unresolved and copied generic rules include #N/A. Requires separate laterality and prescription definition.
excluded_sheets.CHHiP_20Fx: Special prostate regimen; do not equate every 20-fraction course with CHHiP. Requires protocol-specific prescription and target mapping.

unresolved_structures.Target: Generic target role; prescription-specific dose and exact target assignment required.
unresolved_structures.Tumor: Generic tumor role; source threshold is a placeholder and target assignment is unspecified.
unresolved_structures.AugenlidL: Source mixes eyelid and meibomian gland; no safe canonical anatomical equivalence.
unresolved_structures.AugenlidR: Source mixes eyelid and meibomian gland; no safe canonical anatomical equivalence.
unresolved_structures.Dickdarm: Source mixes colon, sigmoid, generic bowel and incompatible anatomical codes; no single stock mapping.
unresolved_structures.Gallengang: Common bile duct is TG263-defined, but source says unspecified bile duct.
unresolved_structures.Bronchus: Source specifies smaller airways; not equivalent to the full bronchial tree or main bronchus.

policy_notes: All stock tables require explicit reviewer confirmation. Fraction count alone is not clinical validation.
Only exact numeric objectives are executable. Source goals and variation values are not optimized, rounded or corrected.
Other source context notes require local review; no cropped organ, suborgan, disease, sex or laterality assumptions.
Legacy CI/GI/HI percentage-output expressions and generic MG target/body placeholders remain review-only.
Source Structure Codes are retained for audit only and are not loaded as matching codes: several are inconsistent with the official nomenclature list.
No prescription linkage, clinical approval or primary-literature validation is implied by the 2024 snapshot.
